## 🐛 Bug Description
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## 🔁 Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See error

## 🎯 Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## 📸 Actual Behavior & Screenshots
What actually occurred. Include error messages, browser console logs, or screenshots.

## 🖥️ Environment Information
- **Operating System**: [e.g. Windows 11, Ubuntu 22.04, macOS Sonoma]
- **Python Version**: [e.g. 3.10.12, 3.11.8, 3.12.2]
- **Browser**: [e.g. Chrome 124, Edge 124, Firefox 125, Safari 17]
- **Execution Mode**: [e.g. Local Server, On-Premise VM, Docker, Static CDN]
- **Telemetry Domain Affected**: [e.g. Intune, SolarWinds, CMDB, Executive Digest, Launcher UI]

## 📋 Server / Pipeline Logs
```text
Paste any relevant terminal or itom_server.log output here
```
